recognize_zh: 這是一張流式細胞儀散點圖（CD3 對 CD5），不是形態學影像；主要的藍色族群 CD3 與 CD5 同時表現，另有一群 CD3 陽性但 CD5 較弱的洋紅色族群，可用來判讀 T 細胞族群的抗原表現。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis) versus CD5-PB (y-axis), log scale, gate labeled [AZ]
Dominant blue population co-expressing CD3 (about 10^2) and CD5 (about 10^1), forming a tight diagonal cluster
Separate magenta CD3-positive population with dimmer to negative CD5 below the main cluster
Scattered red events overlapping the blue CD3+CD5+ cluster
Small green CD3-negative, CD5-negative population near the origin
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot displays CD3 versus CD5 expression within the gated population. The predominant event cluster (blue) shows uniform co-expression of surface CD3 and CD5, consistent with a mature T-cell population, while a separate CD3-positive population with dimmer to absent CD5 (magenta) and a small CD3-negative, CD5-negative population (green) are also present. The colour legend and gating strategy are not provided, so assignment of populations as neoplastic versus residual normal cells cannot be made from this plot alone. Retained CD5 expression on the dominant T-cell population is in keeping with T-prolymphocytic leukemia, which usually expresses CD2, CD3, CD5 and bright CD7.
